title: Al-Qawā'id al-Arba' (The Four Fundamental Principles)
description: Study the four fundamental principles of Islam (القواعد الأربع) by Imam Muhammad ibn Abdul-Wahhab, a foundational text in Salafi methodology. Learn the four questions every person must know about their religion, with lessons from the Salafi Arabic Reading Program.
short_description: Learn the four fundamental principles of Islam by Imam Muhammad ibn Abdul-Wahhab

lessons.content: Introduction to Al-Qawā'id al-Arba' and the first principle: Knowing Allah (معرفته سبحانه)

lessons.title: Lesson 2 - Second Principle
lessons.content: The second principle: Knowing one's religion (معرفة دينه)

lessons.title: Lesson 3 - Third & Fourth Principles
lessons.content: The third principle: Knowing the Prophet and the fourth principle: Knowing the proof
